scope: Static audit of every supabase/migrations/*.sql dated 202610 in exact pinned source; no claim about other months.
Covered schema, RLS/grants, triggers, transaction boundaries, tenant/role invariants, idempotency, data correctness, migration ordering/rollback and cross-module lifecycle.
Related SQL tests were inspected only for coverage; no DB, HTTP, production, secret, PHI, or harness access; no source, migration or test changes.

commands: Verified clean Git worktree HEAD equals snapshot SHA; compared every October migration byte-for-byte against /tmp/clinicai-audit-main-956ba4f2.
nl -ba per migration; large files read in bounded consecutive ranges.
python3 hashlib/line-count inventory for all 101 October migrations and inspected test/runner files.
rg -n '^(BEGIN|COMMIT);' supabase/migrations/202610*.sql to enumerate explicit transaction markers.
controls_and_negative_evidence: The July 30 tenant SQL test checks clinic_id NOT NULL, FK to clinic, leading index and tenant role behavior; it does not assert that cong_no/so_no patient IDs match the referenced visit.
The role-scoped clinical SQL test checks clinical_record and clinical_form_response for doctor/reception/cashier/management; it has no assertion for form_instance_lich_su or luot_ghi_chu.
The stock PostgREST ACL test covers the 11 inventory tables targeted by the October 19 revoke; it does not cover the two clinical history/note tables.
DB-003 in PHAT-HIEN.json is a distinct WIP idempotency issue marked addressed on this exact pinned main; not duplicated.
SEC-011 and SEC-018 are related access-control classes but have different routes/tables/data than SEC-019; DB-005 is tenant provisioning, not patient-visit relation integrity.
unreviewed_or_limits: No migration was applied, replayed, or rolled back in a database; no catalog ACL/RLS state or PostgREST request was inspected.
No production/staging state or customer data was accessed.
Backend behavior may validate patient/visit consistency before INSERT; this audit only establishes that the October DB objects do not enforce it.
SEC-019 role intent needs product-owner confirmation; policy text alone does not establish which screens require access.
DB-006 describes a static transaction boundary/failure window and does not prove it has occurred.
No claim is made about migrations from months outside the assigned October tranche.
